description: This file is a unit test class for the VacancyListRestController in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It contains setup routines and multiple test methods to verify the functionality of GET requests and the handling of unimplemented REST methods such as PUT, POST, and DELETE.

classes.name: VacancyListRestControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the behavior of VacancyListRestController, including data retrieval with GET requests and exception handling for unimplemented methods.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data by loading a YAML fixture before any tests run.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequest
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of vacancies via GET request; verifies the name of the first vacancy.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestCount
methods.description: Checks that the GET request returns 5 vacancies by default.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestWithLimit
methods.description: Verifies that setting a 'limit' parameter to 2 retrieves exactly 2 vacancies.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestWithOffset
methods.description: Ensures that setting an 'offset' of 2 skips the first two vacancies and retrieves the third's details.

methods.name: testHandlePutRequest
methods.description: Verifies that calling handlePutRequest throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitPutValidationRule
methods.description: Verifies that initPutValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitPostValidationRule
methods.description: Verifies that initPostValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Verifies that initDeleteValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.
